book.title: LOS HECHOS Jesús buerã cʉ̃ja ca tiirique

content: Cornelio, Pedrore cʉ̃ ca jʉo dotirique
Cesarea macãre niiupi jĩcʉ̃, cien niirã uwamarã ʉpʉ,
uwamarã cʉ̃ja ca niiri tabe Italiano ca wãme cʉtiri tabe mena ca padegʉ Cornelio ca wãme cʉtigʉ.

Cʉ̃a, cʉ̃ yaa wii macãrã niipetirã menara, ca bojoca añugʉ, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre ca ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉogʉ, judíos cʉ̃ja ca boo pacarijere tii nemogʉ pairo wapa tiirica tiiri tiicojo, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre to birora juu buecõa nii, ca tiigʉ niiupi.
Jĩcã rʉmʉ, muipũ bʉaro cʉ̃ ca aji cõa cũu duwi waari tabe ca niiro, quẽñaricarore biro bii oto weti waagʉ, jĩcʉ̃ Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yʉʉ
cʉ̃re queti wede bojari majʉ, bau niiro cʉ̃ ca niiri tabepʉ jãa eari: —Cornelio —cʉ̃re ca ĩi jãiñagʉre ĩaupi.

To biro cʉ̃re cʉ̃ ca ĩi jãiñaro, Cornelio pea Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pʉto macʉ̃re ĩa, bʉaro uwirique menara: —¿Wiogʉ, ñeere mʉ booti? —cʉ̃re ĩi jãiñupi. To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, o biro cʉ̃re ĩiupi: —Mʉ ca juu buerucurijere, ca boo pacarãre mʉ ca tii nemorijere, cʉ̃re mʉ ca tiicojo nʉcʉ̃ bʉorijere biro ĩami Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ.
To biri Jope macãpʉ jĩcãrãre tiicojoya, Simón ape wãme Pedro ca wãme cʉtigʉre cʉ̃ja jʉorã waajato ĩigʉ.
Waibʉcʉrã quejeri ca padegʉ dia tʉjaro ca niigʉ, cʉ̃re birora Simón ca wãme cʉtigʉ yaa wiire niimi —ĩiupi.

Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pʉto macʉ̃ cʉ̃ mena ca wede niiricʉ cʉ̃ ca waaro jiro, Cornelio pea cʉ̃ paderi maja pʉarãre, to biri jĩcʉ̃ uwamʉ to birora cʉ̃ mena ca niicõa niigʉ Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre ca nʉcʉ̃ bʉogʉre, jʉo cojori,
ca biirique niipetirije cʉ̃jare wede yapano, Jope macãpʉ cʉ̃jare tiicojocã cojoupi.
Pedrore ca bii ĩñorique
Ape rʉmʉ cʉ̃ja pea maapʉ waa nʉnʉa waarã, Jope macãre cʉ̃ja ca ea nʉnʉa waaro, Pedro pea, muipũ jotoa decomacã eagʉ doogʉ cʉ̃ ca biiro, juu buegʉ waagʉ, wii jotoa macã yepa pee mʉa waaupi.
Bʉaro queyari, baarʉgaupi. Cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca baarique queno boja ditoye, jĩcã wãme quẽñaricarore biro bii oto weori cʉ̃re ca bii ĩñorijere ĩaupi.
Ʉmʉreco quejero ca pãa nʉcãro juti quejerore biiri quejero pairi quejero, tii quejero yaparire bapari taberi jiarica quejero yepa pee ca ñaañumu duwi dooro ĩaupi.
Tii quejeropʉre, bapari dʉpori ca cʉorã waibʉcʉrã cʉ̃ja ca niiro cõro, yepa cũari ca waarã, ca wʉʉrã, niiupa.
To biro cʉ̃re ca biiri tabera o biro ca ĩirijere tʉoupi Pedro:Pedrore ca bii ĩñorique. Hch 10.9-15 —Wãmʉ nʉcãña Pedro. Waibʉcʉrãre jĩari baaya —ĩiupe.
To biro ca ĩiro, Pedro pea o biro ĩi yʉʉupi: —Biiticu níja, Ʉpʉ. Yʉa jĩcãti ʉnora ñañarãre, docuorãre, yʉ baa ñaati —ĩiupi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, wederique pea o biro cʉ̃re ĩi nemoupe ñucã: —Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ añurã cʉ̃ ca tiiricarãre, “Ñañarã niima,” ĩiticãña mʉa —ĩiupe.
Itiati peti to biro biiupe. Jiro tii quejero ʉmʉrecopʉ mʉacoaupe ñucã.

Pedro pea to biro cʉ̃re ca bii ĩñorijere, “¿Ñee ʉno petire ĩirʉgaro to biibuti yéé?” cʉ̃ ca ĩi tʉgoeñarique pai niirucurora, Cornelio cʉ̃ ca jʉo doti cojoricarã pea Simón yaa wiire ca jãiña ama nʉnʉa waaricarã, cʉ̃ yaa wii jope petire ea yerijãaupa.
To earãra, tutuaro mena: —¡Cã́jí! ¿Ati wiira to niiti Simón Pedro cʉ̃ ca cãniri wii? —ĩi jãiñaupa.
Ména Pedro pea, cʉ̃re ca bii ĩñorijere cʉ̃ ca tʉgoeña niirora, Añuri Yeri pea o biro cʉ̃re ĩiupʉ: “Ĩaña. Ʉmʉa itiarã mʉre amarã eama.
Wãmʉ nʉcã duwi waa, ‘Yʉ waati,’ ĩitigʉra, cʉ̃ja mena waagʉja. Yʉra yʉ ca tiicojojãrã niima,” cʉ̃re ĩiupi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro Pedro pea duwi waa: —Anora yʉ nii. Yʉra yʉ nii, mʉja ca amagʉ. ¿Ñeere mʉja ĩi doojãri? —cʉ̃jare ĩiupi.

To biro cʉ̃ ca ĩiro, o biro cʉ̃re ĩi yʉʉupa: —Uwamarã wiogʉ Cornelio, ca bojoca añugʉ, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre ca nʉcʉ̃ bʉogʉ, judíos niipetirã cʉ̃ja ca nʉcʉ̃ bʉogʉ cʉ̃ ca doti cojoro jãa doojãwʉ. Jĩcʉ̃ Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ yʉʉ, cʉ̃re queti wede bojari majʉ cʉ̃re baua eari, cʉ̃re jʉo doti cojoya ĩijapi mʉre, cʉ̃ yaa wiipʉ waari, mʉ ca ĩirijere cʉ̃ ca tʉopere biro ĩigʉ —cʉ̃re ĩiupa Pedrore.
To biro cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca ĩirijere tʉo, “Jãa dooya” cʉ̃jare ĩi, tii ñamire toora cãni, ape rʉmʉ cʉ̃ja mena waacoaupi Pedro. Jĩcãrã Jope macã macãrã Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã cʉ̃re bapa cʉti waaupa.
Cornelio yaa wiipʉ Pedro cʉ̃ ca earique
Jĩcã rʉmʉ jiro Cesareare ea waaupa, Cornelio pea cʉ̃ yaarã, cʉ̃ mena macãrã majurope cʉ̃ ca jʉo neoricarã mena yue niiupi.
Pedro, wiipʉ cʉ̃ ca earo, Cornelio cʉ̃re jãi bocagʉ witi waagʉ, cʉ̃re ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉorʉgʉ, cʉ̃ ãjʉro jupeari mena ea nuu waaupi.
To biro cʉ̃ ca biiro ĩa, Pedro pea cʉ̃re wãmʉ nʉcã dotiri, o biro ĩiupi: —Wãmʉ nʉcãña. Yʉ cãa mʉre birora bojocʉ yʉ nii —cʉ̃re ĩiupi.
To biro ĩi, cʉ̃ mena wede peni jãa waagʉ, paʉ bojoca ca nea pooricarãre bʉa eaupi.

Jãa ea, o biro ĩiupi Pedro: —Mʉja añuro mʉja maji, jãare ca dotirije, judíos ca niitirã mena nii dotiti, cʉ̃jare ĩa yuju dotiti, jãare ca biirijere. Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pea jĩcʉ̃ ʉno peerena, “ ‘Ñañagʉ, docuogʉ niimi,’ ĩiticãña,” yʉre ĩi majiojãwi.

To biri yʉre ca jʉorã waaricarãre, “To biro mʉre ĩi cojojãwi,” yʉre cʉ̃ja ca ĩirijere tʉogʉ, “Yʉ waati” ĩitigʉra, yʉ doocã doojãwʉ. To biri yʉ majirʉga ¿ñeere ĩirã yʉre mʉja jʉojãri? —cʉ̃jare ĩiupi Pedro.

To biro Pedro cʉ̃ ca ĩi jãiñaro, o biro cʉ̃re ĩi yʉʉupi Cornelio: —Mee bapari rʉmʉ ametʉa, ano cõrora muipũ bʉaro cʉ̃ ca aji cõa cũu duwi waari tabe ca niiro, ano yʉ yaa wiira juu buegʉ yʉ tiiwʉ. Tee jãa ca ĩiña maniri tabera jĩcʉ̃ ʉmʉ yʉ jʉguerore juti ca ajiyaa boe baterije jãñacãricʉ baua ea,
o biro yʉre ĩiwi: “Cornelio, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ mʉ ca juu buerijere tʉo, ca boo pacarãre mʉ ca tii nemorijere majimi.

To biri Jope macãpʉ jĩcãrãre tiicojoya Simón, cʉ̃ buirica wãme peera Pedro cʉ̃ja ca ĩigʉ, apĩ Simón, waibʉcʉrã quejeri ca padegʉ dia tʉjaro ca niigʉ yaa wiipʉ ca niigʉre cʉ̃ja jʉorã waajato ĩigʉ,” yʉre ĩiwi.

To biri yue mani waaricaro maniro mʉre yʉ jʉo doti cojojãwʉ. Mʉ pea añuro mʉ doojapa. Mecʉ̃ra anore, niipetirã Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ jʉguerore mani nii, to biri Ʉpʉ mʉre cʉ̃ ca ĩi doti cojorique niipetirije jãare mʉ ca wedero jãa tʉorʉga —cʉ̃re ĩi yʉʉupi Pedrore.
Pedro Cornelio yaa wiipʉ cʉ̃ ca wederique
To cõrora Pedro o biro ĩi wede jʉoupi: —Mecʉ̃ra díámacʉ̃ra Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ bojocare cʉ̃ ca ĩa dica wootirijere yʉ maji.
Niipetiri poogaari macãrã cʉ̃re ĩi nʉcʉ̃ bʉo, ca niirore biro añurijere tii, ca tiirãre añuro cʉ̃jare ĩami.
Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ, niipetirã Wiogʉ ca niigʉ Jesucristo mena, Israel yaa pooga macãrãre jĩcãri cõro añuro niirique añurije quetire tiicojoupi.
Mʉja maji ate añurije queti, uwo coerique maquẽre Juan cʉ̃ ca wedero jiro Galilea mena bii jʉo waaro, Judea yepa niipetiropʉ ca bii jeja nʉcã waariquere.

Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ, Jesús Nazaret macʉ̃re Añuri Yeri jʉori, niipetirije cʉ̃ ca tii majipere cʉ̃ ca tiicojoricʉ niiri, ñucã cʉ̃ menara Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ cʉ̃ ca niiro macã añurije maquẽre bojocare tii boja, niipetirã Satanás ñañaro cʉ̃ ca tiirã cãare ametʉene, cʉ̃ ca tii yujurique cãare mʉja maji.
Jãara jãa nii, niipetirije Judea yepare, to biri Jeusalén'pʉre Jesús cʉ̃ ca tiiriquere ca ĩaricarã. Jiro yucʉ tenipʉ cʉ̃re paa pua tuu, cʉ̃re tii jĩa cõacãwa.
To biro cʉ̃re cʉ̃ja ca tii cõacãmijata cãare, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ pee itia rʉmʉ jiro cʉ̃ ca cati tuaro tiiri, jãare cʉ̃ ca baua ĩñoro tiiwi.

Biigʉpʉa niipetirãpʉrena baua ĩñotiwi. Mee jʉgueropʉra Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ, to biro ca biiriquere ca wedeparã jãare cʉ̃ ca beje jeericarã wadore baua ea ĩñowi. Cʉ̃ ca cati tuaricaro jiro, cʉ̃ mena baa, jini, jãa tiiwʉ.
To biri cʉ̃ra, “Bojoca ca catirãre, ca bii yairicarã cãare ca ĩa bejepʉ cʉ̃ ca niiro cʉ̃re tiimi Ʉmʉreco Pacʉ,” ĩi wede dotigʉ jãare tiicojowi.
Ca biipere wede jʉgueri maja niipetirã, mee Jesús yee maquẽrena wede, “Cʉ̃re ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã cõrora cʉ̃ jʉorira ñañarije cʉ̃ja ca tiiriquere acobo eco, biirucuma,” ĩiupa —cʉ̃jare ĩi wedeupi Pedro.
Judíos ca niitirãre Añuri Yeri cʉ̃ ca earique
Ména, Pedro to biro cʉ̃ ca ĩi wede niirora, cʉ̃ ca wederijere ca tʉo niirã niipetirãpʉre Añuri Yeri cʉ̃jare ñaajãa nʉcã eaupi.
To biri Jesucristore ca tʉo nʉnʉjeerã judíos Pedro mena ca waaricarã, Añuri Yeri judíos ca niitirãpʉ cãare cʉ̃ ca ñaajãa nʉcã earijere ĩarã, ĩa ʉcʉacoaupa,
ca tʉoya manirije wederique wede, Ʉmʉreco Pacʉre baja peo nʉcʉ̃ bʉo, cʉ̃ja ca ĩirijere tʉori.
To cõrora Pedro pea o biro ĩiupi: —¿Anija manire birora Añuri Yeri ca ñaajãa nʉcã ecorã, oco mena uwo coericaro cʉ̃ja bootibogajati? —ĩiupi.
To biro ĩi, Jesucristo wãme mena cʉ̃ja ca uwo coe dotiro tiiupi. Jiro, “Jĩcã rʉmʉri jãa mena tuaya mena,” cʉ̃re ĩiupa Pedrore.
